claims.joined_saved_paragraph: Ichika's competence answers a task more readily than it answers what she wants to do with her life. She can prioritize disputes, call urgent backup, finish postponed work, retrieve a child's balloon, learn guitar and surfing quickly, diagnose a propeller problem and accept needed help. None of those capacities establishes a permanent passion, a compelled vocation or effortless social ease. Her central literary problem is the relation between useful contribution and chosen participation: she admires absorbed people, wants a reciprocal role for herself and seeks ordinary company without becoming an imposition. Moderation is one active response to that problem, rather than absence of care. [P01:10077:002–006; 26015:002–006; E48:007/014–030]
claims.extension_limit: Capacity not destiny/cure or effortless ease; helpful acts and failed aims retained.
claims.directed_recipients_and_agency: Ichika chooses participation, reciprocal contribution and company, peers not adult-improvement instruments.
claims.actual_endpoint_and_unfinished_coda: Actual finite work/play/help alongside unresolved vocation.
